sentimento.text1: With 64 days to the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) there was NO new national poll. The latest remains Vox Brasil of Jul 31 (n=2,100, field Jul 26 to 28, margin of 2.15pp, 95% confidence, BR-01084/2026): Lula 40.5% x Flávio Bolsonaro 31.2% in the first round, with Caiado 5.5%, Zema 3.2% and Renan Santos 3.0%, and 47.5% x 41.1% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). The poll of the day is a STATE one and for that reason does not enter the national panel: Datafolha in Pernambuco gives Lula 57% x Flávio 22% in the state, and in the governor's race shows Raquel Lyra at 48% and João Campos at 42%. Across the week, three national polls measured the first-round gap at 9.1pp, 6pp and 9.3pp, and the outlier remains PoderData.
sentimento.text2: The day's cross-reading repeats yesterday's and goes further. Lula ROSE 1.00pp to 65.50%, the MAXIMUM of the AFOS series for a second consecutive day, and the gap WIDENED from +40.15pp to +40.75pp, also a maximum. On both days the opponent rose too, which describes demand for the front-runner and not deterioration on the other side. The asymmetry on the record is this: the price moved 2.00pp across two sessions with NO new national poll in between, so there is no voting-intention reading to accompany the move and the panel asserts no cause. RENAN SANTOS fell 0.55pp to 7.60% (vol USD 8.72M), his lowest value since May 14, and the fall is one of sequence: 12.00% on Jul 23, with 4.40pp given up across nine sessions. Before May 14 the series records lower values, which is why the window is declared.
sentimento.text3: In the market, Lula ROSE 1.00pp to 65.50% (vol USD 7.82M), the maximum of the AFOS series. Flávio rose 0.40pp, to 24.75% (vol USD 7.79M), and even so the gap WIDENED to +40.75pp. Renan Santos fell 0.55pp, to 7.60% (vol USD 8.72M). The whole chasing pack gave ground: Caiado fell 0.25pp, to 1.35% (vol USD 5.24M), Jair Bolsonaro fell 0.30pp, to 0.55%, Camilo Santana gave back 0.90pp and went to 0.45% (vol USD 4.19M), Alckmin gave up 0.10pp, to 0.35%, and Zema was flat at 0.35%. Haddad and Michelle remain at 0.25%, Tereza Cristina rose 0.05pp, to 0.25%, and Tarcísio de Freitas is at 0.05%, with USD 13.69M of accumulated volume, the largest in the book. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market adds up to USD 117.52M.
sentimento.direita: Flávio rose 0.40pp, to 24.75% (vol USD 7.79M), a sixth consecutive session without a fall, and even so saw the gap WIDEN to +40.75pp, because Lula rose more. In the sub-markets the signal favoured him: he RISES 1.00pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place book, to 79.50% (vol USD 216,000), his highest mark in that contract in the panel's tracking, and gives way to 4.95% in third place. Added together, the two moves say the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) position became more consolidated, not less. On ticket-building, however, he remains WITHOUT a running mate four days from the Aug 5 deadline. Tereza Cristina publicly regretted the end of the arrangement after the PP's refusal, saying that what happened is settled, and he thanked her and said he is negotiating with other parties, without naming anyone. On Saturday, Republicanos made official Tarcísio de Freitas's bid for RE-ELECTION as governor of São Paulo, with Flávio present, but Tarcísio himself kept the focus on the state and avoided nationalizing his speech. The panel separates the two: Saturday's convention is a state one, and the national convention, which decides the presidential alliance, is set for Aug 4.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula ROSE 1.00pp to 65.50% (vol USD 7.82M), the maximum of the AFOS series for a second consecutive day, and the gap WIDENED to +40.75pp, also a maximum. The move came with Flávio rising too on both days, which rules out a reading of deterioration of the opponent. There was no new national poll in between, so the price moved 2.00pp across two sessions with no voting-intention reading to accompany it, and the panel records the asymmetry without explaining it. In his camp, the market undid the previous day's move: Camilo Santana gave back 0.90pp and went to 0.45%, his lowest value in the series, below the 0.50% of Jul 30, and Alckmin gave up 0.10pp, to 0.35%. The PCdoB's formal backing still stands and the price returned to its starting point within 24 hours, which is enough for the panel not to link one to the other. On the calendar, the PT makes his candidacy official at a national convention on Aug 2, after state conventions in Ceará on Jul 31 and in Bahia on Saturday. And his camp took a new judicial fact: on the afternoon of Jul 31, André Mendonça authorized a SECOND inquiry into Lulinha, this time over his dealings with Dataprev, a day after the first. An inquiry is not a conviction.
sentimento.terceiraVia: The whole chasing pack shrank, and that is the difference from yesterday, when the signals were crossed. CAIADO fell 0.25pp in the winner contract, to 1.35% (vol USD 5.24M), and COLLAPSED 5.00pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place book, from 27.50% to 22.50% (vol USD 37,000), undoing in a single session the previous day's gain. The series caveat applies and does not describe a collapse: his minimum is 0.90%, from Jul 9, so 1.35% remains above the floor, even if below the 1.80% to 2.40% band in which he traded between Jul 22 and Jul 30. RENAN SANTOS fell 0.55pp, to 7.60%, his lowest value since May 14, and gave up 0.80pp in the first-round second place, to 8.55%, staying FLAT at 61.50% in third. With the price at 7.60% and the polling at 3.0%, the distance between market and poll NARROWED from 5.15pp to 4.60pp, and it narrowed from the price side. CAMILO SANTANA gave back 0.90pp and went to 0.45%, his lowest value in the series. ZEMA was FLAT at 0.35%, interrupting four consecutive sessions of decline, and rose to 4.60% in the third-place book. Tarcísio de Freitas is at 0.05%, with the largest accumulated volume in the book, USD 13.69M, and the AFOS series holds only three days for that name, so the panel records the level without asserting a superlative.
sentimento.polymarket: Lula 65.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 7.82M), Flávio 24.75% (up 0.40pp, vol USD 7.79M), Renan Santos 7.60% (down 0.55pp, vol USD 8.72M), Caiado 1.35% (down 0.25pp, vol USD 5.24M), Jair 0.55% (down 0.30pp), Camilo Santana 0.45% (down 0.90pp, vol USD 4.19M), Alckmin 0.35% (down 0.10pp), Zema 0.35% (flat), Haddad 0.25%, Michelle 0.25%, Tereza Cristina 0.25% (up 0.05pp), Tarcísio 0.05% (vol USD 13.69M). Lula's gap over Flávio at +40.75pp, against +40.15pp on Jul 31, the maximum of the series that begins on May 3. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market at USD 117.52M. Sub-markets: [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place with Flávio 79.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 216,000), Renan Santos 8.55% (down 0.80pp, vol USD 1.09M) and Lula 8.40%; third place with Renan 61.50% (flat, vol USD 165,000), Caiado 22.50% (DOWN 5.00pp, vol USD 37,000), Flávio 4.95% and Zema 4.60%; impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83,000); Senate with the PL at 72.50% (up 0.50pp, vol USD 259,000) and the MDB at 21.35%, below the 24.65% to 26.65% range published yesterday; inflation with the 5.00% to 5.49% band at 38.20% and the 4.50% to 4.99% band at 34.00% (up 0.30pp). The double-reading capture guard failed the first round, with Renan Santos in transit from 7.15% to 7.60% and Caiado's third-place book between 22.00% and 22.50%, and APPROVED the second. All prices go in firm, with no declared range. Live capture Aug 1, 16:49 UTC.

inss.text1: The fiscal agenda had no new fact on Saturday, with the Senate in recess and the Budget as the next front of friction. The political day was one of CONVENTIONS. Republicanos made official Tarcísio de Freitas's bid for re-election as governor of São Paulo, with Flávio Bolsonaro present on the platform and with Tarcísio himself avoiding nationalizing his speech; the party's national convention, which decides the presidential alliance, is only on Aug 4. On the other side, the PT held state conventions in Ceará on Jul 31, with Lula present, and in Bahia on Saturday, where it made official Jerônimo Rodrigues, Jaques Wagner and Rui Costa, and makes Lula's candidacy official at a national convention on Aug 2. Michelle Bolsonaro did not confirm her Senate bid and said she will decide with Jair Bolsonaro.
inss.text2: The market repeated the previous day's move and extended it: Lula rose 1.00pp, to 65.50%, the maximum of the AFOS series for a second consecutive day, and the gap went to +40.75pp, also a maximum. Everything else in the book gave ground or stood still. RENAN SANTOS fell 0.55pp to 7.60% (vol USD 8.72M), his lowest value since May 14, and the fall is one of sequence: 12.00% on Jul 23, with 4.40pp given up across nine sessions. Before May 14 the series records lower values, which is why the window is declared. The whole chasing pack shrank, with Caiado at 1.35%, Camilo Santana at 0.45%, his lowest value in the series, and Jair Bolsonaro at 0.55%. The asymmetry of the day is that none of it had a national poll to accompany it: the latest remains Vox Brasil of Jul 31.
inss.text3: The market for impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice was FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83,000), with no variation across the readings of today's two capture-guard rounds, in a third consecutive session at the same value. The judicial axis did produce a new fact, the second inquiry into Lulinha, but it targets a private individual and not a member of the Court, so a flat price there is not the market's answer to what came out. With USD 83,000 of accumulated volume against USD 117.52M in the presidential market, this contract is only worth recording when it moves in a sustained way.
inss.text4: In the Senate, the PL ROSE 0.50pp to 72.50% (vol USD 259,000), and the MDB FELL to 21.35%, dropping below the 24.65% to 26.65% range in which the panel published it yesterday, in a book of USD 8,000 that does not support a repricing reading. Adding the two, the contract passes 93% of probability assigned to just two parties, which by itself indicates a wide spread. In inflation, the modal band remains 5.00% to 5.49%, at 38.20%, and the 4.50% to 4.99% band rose 0.30pp, to 34.00%, in a book of USD 81,000 that is NOT covered by the guard.
inss.impactoLula: Vox Brasil of Jul 31 did not publish approval and disapproval in this round, so the evaluation picture remains the one from Jul 30, with the week's two opposite readings still standing: PoderData measured personal approval falling to 43% against 49% disapproval, and AtlasIntel, 24 hours earlier, measured it rising 1.7pp, to 47.6% against 51.2%. The panel continues to show AtlasIntel on the gauge, by the criterion it published on Jul 29, the largest sample and the smallest margin in the window. The week's band remains between 43% and 49%.
inss.impactoGestao: The Vox Brasil round of Jul 31 did NOT publish a management rating, so the picture remains the one from Jul 30 and the week's two readings still stand, pointing in opposite directions. PoderData of Jul 30 brought 34% good or very good, 16% fair and 47% poor or terrible, with poor or terrible rising 10pp against the institute's Jul 22 round. AtlasIntel of Jul 29 measured 49.3% poor or terrible, BTG/Nexus of Jul 27 measured 43% and Datafolha of Jul 24 measured 38%. The four institutes still agree on what matters most: management is rated worse than the person, and the distance between the two indicators persists.
inss.conclusao: With 64 days to the election, the day was one of repetition in the market and of calendar in politics. The front-runner's price broke its own top for a second consecutive session, going to 65.50%, and the gap went to +40.75pp, both maxima of the AFOS series. There was no new national poll to accompany it, and the panel records that the price moved 2.00pp across two days with no voting-intention reading in between. In politics, the day was one of conventions: Tarcísio made official for re-election in São Paulo by Republicanos with Flávio on the platform, the PT in state conventions in Ceará and Bahia ahead of the national one on Aug 2, and Michelle Bolsonaro still not confirming her Senate bid. Flávio remains without a running mate four days from the deadline. None of these readings is attributed to a cause: the panel records the coincidence of dates and does not claim the price rose because of them.

bancoMaster.text1: On Saturday the Master case had no new judicial act, and the record is one of follow-through from what came out on Jul 31. Novo filed its petition against senator Jaques Wagner with the Senate Ethics Council, following through on the request announced the day before. What underpins the petition is the Federal Police report made public when André Mendonça lifted the secrecy of part of the investigation: 74 calls between the senator and Augusto Lima, a former partner of the bank, between November 2023 and May 2025, adding up to more than five hours and thirty minutes of conversation across 555 days.
bancoMaster.text2: On the same day the petition was filed, the PT made Jaques Wagner's name official at the state convention in Bahia, alongside Jerônimo Rodrigues and Rui Costa, with party leaders praising his legacy. The panel records both facts side by side and does not turn one into the other: a party petition to the Ethics Council and an official nomination at a convention are distinct processes, and neither decides the other. Wagner publicly said he will prove his innocence. None of this is a conviction.
bancoMaster.text3: On the legislative front there was no news, and the absence remains the fact: the writ of mandamus over the installation of the Banco Master CPI has been sitting for more than four months in Kassio Nunes Marques's office. On price, the record is one of stillness: the market for impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice was FLAT at 3.10%, in a book of USD 83,000, in a third consecutive session at the same value. Yesterday's caveat is worth repeating, because it still applies: this contract does NOT price the Wagner case, which runs against a senator and not against a justice.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The fronts of the Master case run on separate tracks. The criminal one, at the STF under André Mendonça, had its largest movement on Jul 31, with secrecy lifted and the police report made public, and produced no new act on Saturday. The asset front continues in the Rio courts, with freezes. The legislative one has been stalled for more than four months. The party front moved: Novo filed a petition against Jaques Wagner with the Ethics Council. And the front that shares the same rapporteur but is not the Master case got heavier: Mendonça authorized on Jul 31 a SECOND inquiry into Lulinha, this time over Dataprev, a day after the first. The panel records that the same justice holds these investigations and draws from that no reading of intent.

stf.toffoli: Toffoli remains isolated at the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) after the Master crisis, with no fresh individual act captured on Friday.
stf.moraes: No new order from Moraes captured on Friday. The front he opened over the artificial-intelligence video shown at the PL convention remains live, with the 48-hour deadline already expired and the next decision pending.
stf.gilmar: No individual act from Gilmar in the period. The recent joint vote stands, with Dino, Moraes and Zanin, which reduced restrictions on penduricalhos.
stf.dino: No new act on Friday. Still running is the 10-day deadline set on Jul 29 for the government and Congress to specify the responsibility of members of Congress over earmarks.
stf.mendonca: He remains rapporteur of the inquiry opened on Jul 23 into Vorcaro's transfers for the film about Jair Bolsonaro and holds the highest-impact investigations of the period. On Jul 30 he authorized the first inquiry into influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, with the Health Ministry; on the afternoon of Jul 31 he authorized a SECOND one, over his dealings with Dataprev; and on that same Jul 31 he lifted the secrecy of part of the investigation into senator Jaques Wagner in the Master case and authorized monitoring the location of his mobile phone. On Saturday there was no new act.
stf.nexo: Saturday's connecting thread is the PARTY CALENDAR, and the judicial axis enters as inheritance from the previous day. Republicanos made official Tarcísio de Freitas's bid for re-election as governor of São Paulo, with Flávio Bolsonaro on the platform and without Tarcísio himself nationalizing his speech; the party's national convention, which deals with the presidential alliance, is on Aug 4. The PT held state conventions in Ceará and Bahia and makes Lula official on Aug 2. Michelle Bolsonaro did not confirm her Senate bid. Flávio remains without a running mate four days from the Aug 5 deadline, after the PP's refusal on Tereza Cristina. On the judicial axis, the Jul 31 fact that carries into Saturday is the second inquiry into Lulinha, authorized by Mendonça, and Novo's petition against Jaques Wagner with the Ethics Council.
stf.analise: The market for impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice before 2027 was FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83,000), with no variation across the readings of today's two capture-guard rounds. It is the third consecutive session at the same value. The judicial axis produced fact over the period, with two inquiries into Lulinha and the lifting of secrecy over a senator, but none of them points to the removal of a member of the Court, which is what this contract measures. In a book of USD 83,000 against USD 117.52M in the presidential market, a flat price in the face of facts that do not touch the object is the expected behavior.
